summary: Planned mixed-use block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan; the D4D's own Figure 6.2.3 shows two towers up to 280 and 300 ft on this block, the tallest permitted heights on the site, though the D4D's separate height-category text places Block 13 among 'Midrise buildings' (101-145 ft) -- an internal inconsistency in the adopted document that this dossier does not resolve.

milestones.text: Completion expected: Block 13 is not named in any Phase 1-3 block list found (the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list is Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15); only the whole-project buildout target applies
milestones.basis_note: Whole-project buildout target: the October 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment revised construction from six phases to three over the same 16 years, with the final Phase 3 'wrapping up construction in late 2035' per SocketSite (Oct 9, 2020); Block 13 has no dated or phase-specific schedule of its own in any source found.

facts.value: Residential, Institutional, Retail, Non-Retail Sales/Services and PDR uses permitted (limited PDR uses at the lowest floors); Laboratory and Life Science uses Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)

The 2024 annual compliance report's only mention of Block 13 is a preservation design-review requirement for its Illinois Street frontage; no building design review or construction is described

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 13; it is not one of the six buildings named in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list (Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), and no later-phase design review approval was found either.

This dossier's height figures for Block 13 come from this repository's own visual reading of the D4D's Figure 6.2.3 diagram, cross-checked against this repository's existing geometry file (potrero_block_13.geojson), which independently flagged the same 300 ft/280 ft figures as surprising for a block otherwise described in casual references as infrastructure/utility/PDR. The D4D's own Standard 6.2.2 places 'Block 13' in its 'Midrise buildings (101-145 feet)' list, which conflicts with the figure. This is a genuine internal inconsistency in the adopted Design for Development, not a transcription error by this project; flagged for the repository owner rather than resolved here.
No phase-specific schedule found for Block 13; the added expected-completion milestone therefore uses only the whole-project buildout target (2035, SocketSite Oct 2020), not a block-specific date.
